name: Wall Interaction
description: Wall sliding and wall jumping, together, because neither is useful alone: a slide with no jump is a decoration, and a jump with no slide gives the player no time to aim it. It depends on movement.jump_core rather than duplicating it, since both answer input.jump and only one of them may fire — construction order is what lets this suppress the ground jump while the character is on a wall. After a wall jump, horizontal input is ignored for inputLockSeconds, or holding toward the wall re-sticks the character to it immediately and the jump goes nowhere.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: wallProbeDistance
inputs.description: Sideways reach used to detect a wall. Separate from ground_sensor's downward probe: a different surface asked a different question.

inputs.name: slideSpeed
inputs.description: Terminal downward speed while sliding, replacing gravity's acceleration rather than adding to it.

inputs.name: wallJumpVelocity
inputs.description: Upward speed of a wall jump. Matches movement.jump_core's jumpVelocity default so the two read as the same height.

inputs.name: wallKickVelocity
inputs.description: Horizontal speed away from the wall.

inputs.name: inputLockSeconds
inputs.description: How long horizontal input is ignored after a wall jump. Zero means holding toward the wall cancels the kick and the character never leaves.

inputs.name: resetsAirJumps
inputs.description: Whether touching a wall refills jump_core's jump counter.

inputs.name: resetsAirDashes
inputs.description: Whether touching a wall refills movement.dash_ability's air dash budget. Not a dependency: a build may have walls and no dash, so this is a refill request that goes unclaimed when the dash is absent, rather than a call into it.

outputs.name: isWallSliding
outputs.description: Touching a wall is not sliding: sliding also requires being airborne and moving downward.
